title: x.wordcraft.ooxml.embedded — preserved WordprocessingML object markup
description: EXTENSION node of the WordCraft application, safe to skip. Charts, diagrams, ink and embedded objects that were read from a WordprocessingML (.docx) file keep their original markup here, so that saving a .docx again reproduces them exactly. The core nodes hold everything needed to SHOW these objects (drawing items, or a picture); this node adds only the exact original. spec/layouts/x.wordcraft.ooxml.part.layout.txt describes the parts the markup refers to.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload schema: the constant 1.

fragments.description: Small pieces of markup of another format that core payloads refer to by key (their `ooxmlSource`): content the profile does not interpret, kept verbatim so that writing the document back to that format loses nothing. A key is unique in this map; WordCraft uses the first 16 hexadecimal digits of the SHA-256 of `role`, `format` and each string of `xml`, every one followed by one line feed (UTF-8). Absent: none.

role.description: What refers to it. `inline`: an `opaque` inline object; `xml` is one string, the element(s) the object stands for (in WordprocessingML: one `w:r` run or another child of a paragraph). `equation`: an equation's `math`; one string, its `m:oMath` element. `control`: a content control; the strings are, in order, its `w:rPr` element (empty string: none), its `w:sdtEndPr` element (empty string: none), then zero or more further child elements of its `w:sdtPr`, in their original order. `property`: a custom document property of kind `raw`; one string, the XML content of its `property` element.

format.description: The format the markup is in: `docx` for WordprocessingML (ISO/IEC 29500-1).

xml.description: The markup, verbatim; never interpreted by this profile. What each string is depends on `role`.

items.description: One piece of markup (XML text), or an empty string where `role` allows one.

objects.description: The preserved objects, by key. A key is the first 16 hexadecimal digits of the SHA-256 of the object's `xml` followed by one line feed and, for each reference in order, `id`, tab, `kind`, tab, `target`, tab, `E` or `I` (external or internal), line feed; all UTF-8.

additionalProperties.description: One object read from a WordprocessingML file, kept so that writing such a file again reproduces it exactly.

xml.description: The object's own markup as one standalone XML element with its namespace declarations: the `a:graphic` of a chart, diagram or ink drawing, an `mc:AlternateContent`, or the `w:object` of an embedded (OLE) object. ISO/IEC 29500-1. Verbatim; never interpreted by this profile.

refs.description: The relationships the markup uses, in order.

id.description: The relationship id the markup uses (`rId5`).

kind.description: The relationship type, a URI used as a name (never fetched).

target.description: For an internal relationship: the package part name, which is the `name` in the descriptor of an `x.wordcraft.ooxml.part` node of this capsule. For an external relationship: a NOTE of the outside address the original file pointed at (a linked workbook, a linked picture); it is provenance and is never followed.

external.description: true: the target is outside the original package (not carried); false: it is a part carried in this capsule.
